description: This file contains implementation of the FakeProofSource class used for testing in the quic namespace, including methods for handling proof and signature operations, managing pending operations, and interacting with delegate proof sources.

classes.name: FakeProofSource
classes.description: A mock implementation of ProofSource used for testing, capable of managing proof and signature requests, and queuing pending operations.

classes.name: FakeProofSource::GetProofOp
classes.description: Represents a proof request operation with associated data and callback.

classes.name: FakeProofSource::ComputeSignatureOp
classes.description: Represents a signature computation operation with associated data and callback.

methods.name: FakeProofSource
methods.description: Constructor initializing the delegate proof source for testing.

methods.name: GetProof
methods.description: Initiates a proof request, either directly or by queuing as a pending operation.

methods.name: ComputeTlsSignature
methods.description: Initiates a TLS signature computation, either directly or by queuing as a pending operation.

methods.name: GetCertChain
methods.description: Retrieves the certificate chain from the delegate proof source.

methods.name: GetTicketCrypter
methods.description: Returns the ticket crypter, either from internal storage or delegate.

methods.name: NumPendingCallbacks
methods.description: Returns the number of pending callback operations.

methods.name: InvokePendingCallback
methods.description: Runs and removes the pending callback at the specified index.
